statement_summary: Security lead and CMMC Affirming Official designated in writing
Annual risk assessment with SP 800-30; every risk owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; federal representation risks never accepted
Sanctions recorded; good-faith reporting protected
Security review and contract terms before a vendor holds FCI or Restricted data
Call-back, Owner approval, log, and 5-day hold for every bank change; monthly change report
Annual assessment; affirmations and representations only after evidence and counsel review
No Section 889 covered equipment; actual manufacturer confirmed in writing
Flow down FAR 52.204-21, 52.204-25, and the CMMC level; check subcontractor status
Annual policy review; written, time-limited exceptions
Unique accounts; no shared mailbox password or shared tablet sign-in
Least privilege; limited SYS-01, SYS-02, and bank portal rights; restricted folders
MFA everywhere, including MSP-held administrator logins; security keys for payment roles
Termination checklist completed on or before the last day
External users removed at closeout; quarterly user review
12-character passwords in a password manager; default passwords changed
Only enrolled devices reach FCI; passcode, encryption, remote wipe, 10-minute lock
Visitors on a separate guest Wi-Fi; staff Wi-Fi password changed yearly and at departures
Key and alarm code list; visitor sheet and escort; containers locked; nothing left in vehicles
Pre-posting check for federal project content
MSP and vendor staff use named accounts with MFA; annual technician list
Never act on a bank change received by email, text, or inbound call
No company data in personal accounts or public AI chatbots; print through SYS-01
Training at hire and yearly with payment-fraud module and phishing simulations
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour by phone or in person
Bank recall within the hour, bank-change freeze, and IC3 complaint for suspected payment diversion
Record the breach determination date; state notices on the P08 matrix deadlines
Section 889 reports within 1 and 10 business days
Export logs at incident start; covered defense information check in every incident
regulatory_driver: N23-R03 (252.204-7012(c)-(e) if CDI is ever held)

statement_summary: Annual tabletop with the MSP; lessons learned within 30 days
CUI not accepted; quarantine and notify the Contracting Officer
FCI only on approved systems; automatic forwarding blocked
Encryption at rest on every device and in transit
Approved AI tools only; no FCI in the AI tool before enterprise terms
Daily backup, 90-day immutable retention, MFA on the console, quarterly restore tests
Wipe or destroy media with records, including leased printer and plotter storage
6-year retention of security records and CMMC evidence; 3 years for certified payrolls
